project.projectDesc: Provides a Flask-backed access layer for organizing and retrieving operational data used in energy and telecom reporting.

caseStudy.summary: This backend application organizes operational data for reporting and analysis in energy and mobile-network contexts. I contributed Python Flask services and data-access work supporting a structured data-warehouse layer.
caseStudy.challenge: Energy and telecom systems produce operational data across different sources and schemas. The application needed to make selected data easier to collect, organize, and retrieve for downstream reporting and decision-making.
caseStudy.architecture: A Flask application exposes backend access to a database-backed warehouse layer. Data is organized into structured records so that reporting and analytics can use a consistent access pattern.
caseStudy.diagram:
flowchart LR
  Energy[Energy data sources] --> Ingest[Data preparation]
  Telecom[Telecom data sources] --> Ingest
  Ingest --> Warehouse[MySQL data warehouse]
  Warehouse --> Flask[Flask API]
  Flask --> Users[Reporting and analysis users]
contributions: Developed backend components for a Python Flask application.
Supported data access and database-backed data-warehouse functionality.
Worked with SQL and structured operational data for energy and telecom use cases.
tradeoffs: A structured warehouse supports consistent reporting, while source-specific data still requires careful mapping.
A Flask API separates application access from storage details but introduces a service boundary to maintain.
Domain-specific reporting depends on clear field definitions and mappings from each source.

business: The application organizes operational data for reporting.
quality: Structured data access supports consistent downstream analysis.
